jobs.title: Senior Manager, Project Management
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (3 days/week in office)
jobs.why: Exceptional healthcare operations and systems fit: cross-functional program leadership, operational excellence, process standardization, root-cause analysis, executive reporting, implementation, change management, and training/process decisions inside a tech-enabled health plan.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 6+ years of healthcare program/project management, change management, and health-plan operational problem solving. Treat tenure and payer-specific depth as the main stretch; emphasize healthcare operations, systems projects, workflow redesign, reporting, training, and implementation ownership.

jobs.title: Manager Operational Excellence
jobs.location: New York, NY · On-site / hybrid depending team
jobs.why: Very strong hospital operations/process-improvement match covering end-to-end operational improvement, strategic planning, performance metrics, root-cause analysis, implementation roadmaps, governance, workforce planning, and executive-facing recommendations.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 5+ years in consulting, operational excellence, strategy, or equivalent work and expects strong analytical modeling. Emphasize healthcare operations, business analysis, dashboards/reporting, process improvement, project leadership, and cross-functional execution without overstating advanced modeling depth.

jobs.title: Healthcare Consulting Manager [Primary Care/Behavioral Health]
jobs.why: Excellent domain alignment with primary care and behavioral health plus healthcare workflows, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, project management, process improvement, telehealth workflows, HIPAA-aware operations, and client-facing execution.
jobs.gap: Consulting-manager seniority and deeper coding/revenue-cycle credentials are the main risks; CPC is preferred and the role may expect stronger formal consulting experience. Lead with behavioral-health operations, intake/workflow systems, SharePoint/Power Automate work, training, and cross-functional project delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote · occasional NYC travel
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech growth-operations fit centered on sales/account-management workflows, process scaling, systems strategy, operational issue resolution, data-driven decision support, and cross-functional execution at a growth-stage healthcare company.
jobs.gap: The role is senior and analytically demanding, with likely expectations for deeper RevOps tooling and quantitative analysis. Position SQL only as foundational/working knowledge and emphasize CRM/workflow systems, reporting, process design, operations, and healthcare domain experience.

jobs.title: EverHealth - Sales Operations Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote or Denver hybrid
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS operations role with strong overlap in CRM/process ownership, sales operations, reporting, systems alignment, workflow improvement, and cross-functional execution across a health-focused software portfolio.
jobs.gap: The role likely expects deeper formal sales-operations ownership and advanced CRM/revenue analytics. Emphasize Salesforce/CRM exposure, workflow automation, reporting, process improvement, and healthcare/technology operations while keeping SQL at foundational/working level.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Practice Operations - Mental Health
jobs.why: Highly relevant mental-health operations leadership covering national care-delivery operations, patient experience, reporting, team leadership, operational design, financial performance, and cross-functional execution in virtual care.
jobs.gap: This is a substantial seniority stretch: the role seeks 7+ years of operational leadership in multispecialty/ambulatory care and oversight of large distributed teams. Apply as a reach and emphasize behavioral-health operations, training, workflow design, metrics, and program ownership without inflating leadership scope.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Healthcare
jobs.why: Healthcare-focused program-management role involving service growth, program implementation, operational execution, cross-functional initiatives, and maintaining scalable operating programs. Strong match for project/program coordination and process ownership.
jobs.gap: KBS is a facilities-services company rather than a healthcare provider or health-tech company, and the role may emphasize large service-delivery operations more than systems automation. Position program management, process improvement, reporting, and healthcare operational exposure as the transferable core.

jobs.title: Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.location: United States · Remote · East Coast preferred
jobs.why: Strong systems-heavy implementation role involving strategic accounts, implementation roadmaps, stakeholder management, analytics-driven work, process design, customer onboarding, and high-touch cross-functional execution.
jobs.gap: The product domain is compensation/pay governance rather than healthcare and the role requires comfort with pay-equity analysis and demanding enterprise accounts. Emphasize implementation ownership, workflow/process design, reporting, training, and stakeholder management.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare software plus systems-oriented marketing operations is a useful bridge role: HubSpot, funnel workflows, reporting, tool integrations, pipeline infrastructure, AI-enabled optimization, and cross-functional RevOps work are central rather than SEO.
jobs.gap: The role expects deep HubSpot and modern martech-stack ownership. Emphasize CRM/workflow automation, reporting, prior marketing background, process design, and systems fluency; do not overstate specific HubSpot administration depth if not held.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Pardot Administrator)
jobs.why: Systems-heavy growth operations role focused on CRM/marketing automation, Salesforce integration, data cleanup, workflow automation, attribution/reporting quality, AI-enabled workflows, documentation, and vendor/tool coordination rather than SEO.
jobs.gap: Deep Pardot administration, GA4, 6sense, ZoomInfo, and data-quality tooling are explicit requirements and represent a meaningful technical gap. Treat as a stretch and lead with transferable CRM, automation, reporting, QA, and workflow-management experience.
